title: Venezuelan Creamy Plantain Bowl
description: A delicious Venezuelan-inspired dish featuring creamy plantains in a bowl. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the plantain slices to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
In a blender or food processor, combine the cheese, cream, and a pinch of salt.
Blend the mixture until it is smooth and creamy.
Add the cooked plantains to the blender and blend until they are well coated with the cheesy mixture.
Spoon the plantain mixture into individual bowls.
